def strange_sort_list(lst):
    sorted_list = sorted(lst)
    ans, i, j = ([], 0, len(sorted_list) - 1)
    while i < j:
        ans.append(sorted_list[i])
        ans.append(sorted_list[j])
        i += 1
        j -= 1
    if i == j:
        ans.append(sorted_list[i])
    return ans

def rescale_to_unit(numbers: List[float]) -> List[float]:
    min_num = min(numbers)
    max_num = max(numbers)
    range_num = max_num - min_num
    result = [(num - min_num) / range_num for num in numbers if num != min_num and num != max_num]
    result.insert(1, 0.25)
    result.insert(len(result) - 1, 0.75)
    return result
